market.question: Will Bitcoin dip to $50,000 by December 31, 2026?

assessment.reasoning: BTC spot ~$78,300; reaching $50k requires a ~36% drop by Dec 31, 2026 with no prior touch since Nov 24, 2025. Conservative analysts allow $60-75k floor; $50k is in the deeper bear tail but not extreme over 8 months given options pricing showing significant downside skew. Roughly 1-in-4 odds.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Whether a recession or risk-off cascade develops in 2026 H2.
